source: Claude, d'après l'arbre du dépôt et le README
explication_en: All the logic lives in the static class ASCII.php, which loads on demand per-language replacement tables and transliteration tables per Unicode plane (x000.php and following) from the data folder. PHPUnit tests, PHPStan analysis and composer.json frame this code with no external dependency.
